name: Chloe Thurg
source:
Your roommate at Twinewood Academy. Whilst a little shy and awkward with people, Chloe is kindhearted and longs for companionship. Her goblin obsession seems to be based around human nerd culture with the little greenskin being absolutely obsessed with anime and games.

[In game description]
